Name: Monster Hutch Starter Pack
Author: juminos
Description:
This content pack adds several monsters found in the game along with a few new variants which can be incubated in the Monster Incubator and will produce overnight. It also adds a few new charmer rings.

[size=4]Monsters
[/size][list]
[*]Bats: 5 variants of bat can be created by putting a mummified bat in the Monster Incubator. Drops bat wings (like how rabbits drop their feet) and sometimes fruit overnight. Each watered bat will produce.
[*]Crabs: 4 variants of ore crab can be created by putting 10 of the respective ore (copper, iron, gold, iridium), a truffle crab by putting 1 truffle, or a stick bug by putting 1 ginger in the Monster Incubator. Ore crabs shed their "shell" about every other night leaving an ore node you can break for ore (double the usual yield). Each watered crab has a 50% chance to produce each night.
[*]Dust Sprite: Created by putting 10 coal in the Monster Incubator. Makes coffee or sometimes triple shot espresso overnight. Every 5 watered dust sprites will produce.
[*]Magma Sprite/Sparker: Created by putting 10 cinder shards in the Monster Incubator. Leaves cinder shard ores and sometimes obsidian overnight. Every 2 watered magma sprites or sparkers (must be 2 of the same variant) will produce.
[*]Spider: Created by putting 10 bug meat in the Monster Incubator. Leaves bug meat or sometimes void essence overnight. Each watered spider will produce.
[/list]
[size=4]Rings[/size][list]
[*]Bat Charmer Ring: charms all variants of bats. Acquired from the dwarf after reaching the bottom of the mines.
[*]Crab Charmer Ring: the crabshell ring has been modified to charm all variants of crab. Acquired the usual way.
[*]Dust Charmer Ring: charms dust sprites. Acquired from Jas in the mail once you become good enough friends. (Available for purchase from Dwarf after that)
[*]Magma Charmer Ring: charms magma sprites and sparkers. Acquired from volcano dwarf.
[*]Shadow Charmer Ring: allows all shadow people to recognize you as an ally. Acquired from Krobus once you become close enough friends. (Available for purchase from Dwarf after that)

[*]Slime Charmer Ring: this mod just adds the ability to 'pet' slimes with this charmer ring
[*]Spider Charmer Ring: charms spiders. Acquired from Dwarf once you've unlocked the dangerous mines.
[/list]
Each charmer ring allows you to 'pet' the associated monster which shows a heart bubble and makes a monster sound (or in the case of shadow people they will greet you). This feature will work both in and outside the hutch but can be configured individually to only work in the hutch.
